title: Plugin-quality team config
description: Schema for plugin-quality.yaml in a repository's convention home (default docs/conventions): the verification level of the plugin-quality plugin, read by /plugin-quality:audit and listed in plugins/plugin-quality/reference/config.md. The plugin's other keys stay in the topic doc <home>/plugin-quality/README.md. Contract: docs/adr/0064-home-plugin-customization-in-docs-conventions-yaml.md.

verification.description: How much independent checking this plugin's skills run: off, light (the default: skip the verifier dispatch), standard (run it) or strict (also run the optional passes). Read from the default branch's committed copy only, so a branch cannot lower it. Levels: docs/contracts/verification-level/README.md.

verification_skills.description: Per-skill verification level, keyed by skill name (for example audit); an entry beats this file's verification value.
